def indep_max(n, S):

    allowed=[x for x in range(1,n) if x not in S]
    best=[1]
    def rec(cand, size):
        if size>best[0]: best[0]=size
        if size+len(cand)<=best[0]: return
        for i,v in enumerate(cand):
            if size+len(cand)-i<=best[0]: return
            newc=[u for u in cand[i+1:] if (u-v)%n not in S]
            rec(newc,size+1)
    rec(allowed,1)
    return best[0]
def search(n, a):
    half=list(range(1,n//2+1))
    found=None
    def classes_to_S(C):
        S=set()
        for d in C:
            S.add(d%n); S.add((-d)%n)
        return S
    def ok_sumfree(S):
        for x in S:
            for y in S:
                if (x+y)%n in S: return False
        return True
    # enumerate subsets of classes, size-limited by degree
    for r in range(1,len(half)+1):
        for C in itertools.combinations(half,r):
            S=classes_to_S(C)
            if len(S)>a: break
            if not ok_sumfree(S): continue
            if indep_max(n,S)<=a:
                return sorted(S)
    return None
